_how_to_edit: League notices shown at the top of the Pulse page. Edit this file on GitHub (pencil icon), commit, and the site updates within a few minutes. Each notice needs a title. Optional: date (YYYY-MM-DD, shown as a countdown), time, location, details, link, show_from and show_until (YYYY-MM-DD; a dated notice disappears by itself the day after its date). Remove a notice by deleting its block. Trades are added automatically and do not belong here.

notices.title: League event
notices.details: Save the date. Location and time to follow.
